nature: Exploratory retrospective supplement after inspecting the original results; specified before running these comparisons
primary_model: Saved fixed XGBoost; no training, retuning or ML threshold reselection
cohorts: The existing four record-order test blocks, separately and pooled with preserved phase boundaries; no holdout analysis
grade_interpretation: UCI explicitly defines the seismic severity order. The common ordered coding is adopted for the two other assessments, whose ARFF domains are also a,b,c,d; these are study comparators, not verified deployed mine rules.
selection: For each field separately, apply unchanged A/B/C objectives to the same historical reference rows; freeze the selected cutoff for the matching test rows. Do not select a best field from test performance.
candidate_convention: One canonical threshold per distinct reference alert set: +inf for none, -inf for all, otherwise the minimum included observed grade score. Absent grade levels do not create duplicate reference decisions. Equal grades move together; B/C loss ties choose fewer alerts.
comparisons: Each frozen policy minus no alarms
Fixed XGBoost minus each of the three historically selected grade policies under the same rule and selection settings

bootstrap.seed_rule: seed + fold + 1; pooled fold=-1; identical row draws for every comparison

interval_scope: Unadjusted percentile intervals conditional on frozen models, selected policies and current rows; no refitting or reselection uncertainty; record order remains a temporal proxy
reporting: Per-phase results are primary. Display r=10 and all four budgets, with A/B/C retained. Full cost combinations are saved. A is selected once per budget and evaluated at each cost; B is selected once per cost without a capacity condition.
